name: exact-mr-review-keeps-dirty-worktree-read-only
description: Pins the current MR patchset and preserves a dirty checkout during a review-only task.
prompt: Review Go MR !123. The current checkout has unrelated staged, unstaged, and untracked work. Only review and report in Chinese; do not change code or touch the remote MR.
trap: The reviewer stashes or cleans the worktree, reviews local HEAD instead of the MR source SHA, or silently uses a guessed base branch.

assertions.text: Reads applicable repository instructions before inspecting the diff.
Refreshes authoritative MR metadata and records exact base and source commit SHAs or stops if they cannot be obtained.
Does not stash, clean, reset, switch, edit, commit, push, publish comments, or otherwise mutate the checkout or remote MR.
Uses the pinned commits for both diff and source context, such as git show source_sha:path, so unrelated working-tree changes cannot contaminate evidence.
Produces a Chinese findings-first verdict with exact file and line anchors plus validation limits.

name: working-tree-review-includes-untracked-go-files
description: Covers staged, unstaged, and untracked files when the user asks to review current local changes.
prompt: Review the current Go working-tree changes. A new untracked handler file is part of the work and has not been git-added yet.
trap: The reviewer runs only git diff HEAD and silently omits the untracked file.

assertions.text: Includes staged and unstaged changes relative to HEAD.
Enumerates untracked files with git ls-files --others --exclude-standard and includes their content in scope.
States the exact working-tree scope instead of presenting it as a committed branch or MR diff.
Does not git add the untracked file merely to make diff tooling see it.

name: go-version-aware-range-loop-review
description: Avoids reporting a pre-Go-1.22 range-variable warning when the module targets a newer language version.
prompt: Review this diff in a module whose go.mod says `go 1.23`: `for _, item := range items { go func() { process(item) }() }`.
trap: The reviewer mechanically reports the historical range-loop closure bug without checking the module's Go language version.

assertions.text: Checks the go directive and any workspace/toolchain constraints before applying version-sensitive Go rules.
Does not report the pre-Go-1.22 per-iteration range-variable capture bug for a Go 1.23 module.
Still checks whether item points to shared mutable state or whether goroutine lifecycle and cancellation create a different concrete bug.
Does not turn a non-issue into a style suggestion merely to produce output.

name: request-context-contract-loss
description: Finds a concrete cross-layer context propagation regression and explains its trigger and impact.
prompt: Review a Go HTTP-handler diff that replaces `s.store.Get(r.Context(), id)` with `ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second); defer cancel(); s.store.Get(ctx, id)`. The repository propagates tracing and tenant identity through request context.
trap: The reviewer praises the timeout or raises only generic context style, missing that Background severs cancellation, trace, and tenant values.

assertions.text: Reports that deriving from context.Background severs the request context contract.
Names concrete impact: client cancellation no longer stops the store call and request-scoped trace or tenant values are lost.
Suggests context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), ...) as the smallest fix.
Anchors the finding to the changed source line and assigns severity and confidence from the demonstrated trigger path.

name: large-diff-grouping-without-unrequested-subagents
description: Reviews a large cross-package change by functional groups while respecting an explicit no-subagent constraint.
prompt: Review a 60-file Go branch diff spanning handler, service, repository, migrations, config, and Helm. Do not use subagents. Keep the review local and read-only.
trap: The reviewer either starts subagents anyway, samples only a few files, or reviews each directory independently and misses changed cross-group contracts.

assertions.text: Does not spawn or delegate to subagents.
Groups files by behavior, call chain, or shared contract rather than arbitrary file-count chunks.
Reviews every group sequentially and then performs a cross-group pass for API, interface, config, schema, generated-code, and deployment consistency.
Records any coverage limitation instead of claiming whole-diff coverage without evidence.

name: inline-comment-publication-refreshes-and-verifies
description: Publishes only explicitly authorized, current-patchset findings and verifies the remote result.
prompt: The local report for Go MR !456 has two findings. I now explicitly authorize you to submit them as inline comments. The MR may have received a new patchset since the report was written.
trap: The reviewer reuses stale commit IDs and line numbers, duplicates existing discussions, or claims success after draft creation without read-back.

assertions.text: Refreshes MR metadata, current patchset, exact diff, and existing discussions before publishing.
Revalidates each finding against current code and drops or rewrites resolved, outdated, duplicated, or moved findings.
Publishes only confirmed findings on current changed lines, with short actionable Chinese wording.
Reports publication success only after reading back comment IDs, positions, patchset or commit SHAs, and non-outdated thread state.

name: deep-review-separates-maintainability-from-defects
description: Adds concrete simplification guidance without turning design preferences into merge-blocking findings.
prompt: Do a deep Go code review of this MR, including architecture, maintainability, and simplification. The changed code adds a fourth copy of the same status mapping, but all current branches are behaviorally correct.
trap: The reviewer calls duplication a P1/P2 bug, forces a nine-section template, recommends a design pattern without showing reduced complexity, or omits the requested maintainability assessment.

assertions.text: Keeps the behaviorally correct duplication out of P0-P2 findings and the merge verdict.
Reports a concrete non-blocking recommendation anchored to the repeated mapping and names its current change cost.
Suggests the smallest behavior-preserving consolidation at the owning boundary instead of a broad rewrite.
Omits empty architecture or design-pattern sections and does not introduce a named pattern unless it materially reduces concepts.

name: review-only-does-not-turn-into-rewrite
description: Preserves the review-only boundary even when the code could be substantially simplified.
prompt: Review this Go change only; do not modify files. The main function is long and mixes orchestration, mapping, and I/O. Tell me what must block merge and what could be simplified later.
trap: The reviewer edits files, emits a wholesale replacement implementation, or mixes optional restructuring into the blocking defect list.

assertions.text: Does not edit files or treat a review request as authorization to apply a refactor.
Uses the normal finding gate for merge blockers and keeps optional structural improvements in a separate non-blocking section.
Anchors simplification advice to concrete responsibilities or change risks and proposes staged, behavior-preserving steps.
Provides only concise fix directions unless the user separately asks to see code or apply changes.
